entries.original_title: IDH mutation impairs histone demethylation and results in a block to cell differentiation
entries.original_authors: Lu, C.; Ward, P. S.; Kapoor, G. S.; Rohle, D.; Turcan, S.; Abdel-Wahab, O.; Edwards, C. R.; Khanin, R.; Figueroa, M. E.; Melnick, A.; Wellen, K. E.; O’Rourke, D. M.; Berger, S. L.; Chan, T. A.; Levine, R. L.; Mellinghoff, I. K.; Thompson, C. B.
entries.description: Protocol 1 replicates the original claim that mutant IDH1 and IDH2 increase global histone methylation and produce the oncometabolite 2HG in transfected 293T cells.
entries.citation_sentence: Examination of glioma samples showed a correlation between IDH mutation status and level of overall methylation (Lu et al., 2012). In Figure 1B, Lu and colleagues examined the effects of mutations in IDH1 and IDH2 on global levels of methylation by transfecting mutant and wild type forms of the genes into 293T cells and using Western blot to assess the levels of various methylation markers.
entries.notes: Registered report protocol; no replication outcome is reported, so the result is inconclusive.

entries.original_title: IDH mutation impairs histone demethylation and results in a block to cell differentiation
entries.original_authors: Lu, C.; Ward, P. S.; Kapoor, G. S.; Rohle, D.; Turcan, S.; Abdel-Wahab, O.; Edwards, C. R.; Khanin, R.; Figueroa, M. E.; Melnick, A.; Wellen, K. E.; O’Rourke, D. M.; Berger, S. L.; Chan, T. A.; Levine, R. L.; Mellinghoff, I. K.; Thompson, C. B.
entries.description: Protocol 2 replicates the original claim that expression of mutant IDH2 blocks differentiation of 3T3-L1 progenitor cells into adipocytes.
entries.citation_sentence: Examination of glioma samples showed a correlation between IDH mutation status and level of overall methylation (Lu et al., 2012). In Figure 2A and B, they transfect undifferentiated 3T3-L1 cells with the wild type and mutant forms of IDH2 and assess the cells’ ability to differentiate into adipocytes, as determined by staining for lipid droplets with Oil-Red-O.
entries.notes: Registered report protocol; no replication outcome is reported, so the result is inconclusive.

entries.description: Protocol 3 replicates the original claim that knockdown of the histone demethylase KDM4C increases global methylation and inhibits differentiation of 3T3-L1 cells into adipocytes.
entries.citation_sentence: Examination of glioma samples showed a correlation between IDH mutation status and level of overall methylation (Lu et al., 2012). In Figure 4D, they use siRNAs to knock down levels of KDM4C in differentiating 3T3-L1 cells.
entries.notes: Registered report protocol; no replication outcome is reported, so the result is inconclusive.
